text: Arm introduces in-house server chip and projects substantial revenue expansion. Company transitions from IP licensing to direct product competition with existing customers. Multiple major firms commit as initial buyers while peer chip equities rise concurrently.

meta.note: Simultaneous partnership and competition create overlap between supplier and customer roles.

text: Jury assigns negligence to Meta and YouTube with damages allocated between firms. Design features such as algorithms and autoplay are examined in court. Parallel litigation proceeds across jurisdictions with similar claims. Appeals are initiated while additional trial phases remain pending.

meta.note: Concurrent rulings across cases reinforce shared legal framing without unified final resolution.

text: U.S.-China leader meeting is rescheduled to mid-May with reciprocal visit framework maintained. Adjustment occurs alongside active Middle East conflict. Preparations proceed without change to bilateral engagement format or participation.

meta.note: Schedule shift reflects external constraint without altering underlying diplomatic structure.
